info.title: Inventory Management System API Documentation (Version 2)
info.description: API documentation for the Inventory Management System built with Laravel and documented using OpenAPI (Swagger). This documentation provides details about the available endpoints, request/response formats, authentication methods, and other relevant information for developers integrating with the IMS API.

post.summary: Login user and receive JWT token
post.description: User provides email and password. API returns user details and JWT Bearer token.
API generates a token and sends a password reset email with secure URL token.
Validate token + email + password and update the user password.

error.example: This password reset token is invalid.

get.description: Retrieve company information including general details and banking information.
Retrieve a paginated list of product categories.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Search product categories by category name

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort product categories by a field (created_at, updated_at, category_name)

post.description: Create a new product category with name, label color, and optional description.

get.summary: Get a product category by ID
get.description: Retrieve details of a specific product category.

patch.description: Update product category details. Only provided fields will be updated.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of raw material categories.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Search raw material categories by category name and description

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort raw material categories by a specific field (e.g., created_at, updated_at, category_name)

post.summary: Create a new raw material category
post.description: Create a new category with name, label color, and optional description.

get.summary: Get a raw material category by ID
get.description: Retrieve details of a specific raw material category.

patch.summary: Update an existing raw material category
patch.description: Update category details. Only provided fields will be updated.

get.description: Retrieve a single user by specifying the user ID.

post.description: Update user information. For file uploads, use POST method with `_method: PATCH` as a parameter.

_method.description: Set this to PATCH to emulate PATCH request using POST

get.summary: Get all users with pagination, filters, and sorting
get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all users. Supports filtering, sorting, and search.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Search by name, email, or phone number

post.description: Create a new system user. Supports uploading profile picture and sends identity verification email.
Verify a user's email address using the provided verification token.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Search warehouse by warehouse name and warehouse manager

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort warehouses by a specific field (e.g., created_at, updated_at, warehouse_manager)

post.description: Store a new warehouse with optional images.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific warehouse.

patch.description: Update warehouse information and optionally append more images.

delete.description: Remove a warehouse image from storage and database.
